description_en: Performs a paged query on memories in a memory store. Supports paging and filtering by associate scope, content type, source, validity status, and update time. Unspecified scope dimensions are excluded from filtering. If valid is omitted, only valid memories are returned. If valid is set to false, revoked memories are returned
description_zh: 分页查询记忆库中的记忆，可按关联范围、内容类型、来源、有效状态和更新时间筛选。未指定的范围维度不参与筛选。valid 省略时仅返回有效记忆，false 返回已撤销的记忆
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore list-memories --workspace-id ws-2f5f9c5a8d0e4c3b --memory-store-name customer-memory --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListMemories

parameters.help_en: The name of the memory store
parameters.name: memory_store_name

parameters.help_en: The user ID. If not specified, all users are matched. The length is limited to 1 to 128 UTF-8 bytes. The value cannot contain a forward slash (/) or an asterisk (*)
parameters.help_zh: 用户 ID，不传时匹配全部用户，长度限制 1 - 128 UTF-8 字节，不允许包含 / 或使用 *
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The business team ID defined by the caller
parameters.help_zh: 由调用方定义的业务团队标识
parameters.name: team_id

parameters.help_en: The agent ID. If not specified, all agents are matched. The length is limited to 1 to 128 UTF-8 bytes. The value cannot contain a forward slash (/) or an asterisk (*)
parameters.help_zh: Agent ID，不传时匹配全部 Agent，长度限制 1 - 128 UTF-8 字节，不允许包含 / 或使用 *
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en: The session ID. If not specified, all sessions are matched. The length is limited to 1 to 128 UTF-8 bytes. The value cannot contain a forward slash (/) or an asterisk (*)
parameters.help_zh: Session ID，不传时匹配全部 Session，长度限制 1 - 128 UTF-8 字节，不允许包含 / 或使用 *
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The memory content types. Specify the value as a JSON array string, such as ["skill"]. Valid values: semantic, skill, user_profile, and session_summary. If this parameter is omitted or set to [], all types are queried. The value auto is not supported. Keep the filter conditions consistent when you retrieve subsequent pages
parameters.help_zh: 以 JSON 数组字符串传入，例如 ["skill"]。支持 semantic、skill、user_profile、session_summary；省略或 [] 表示全部类型，不接受 auto。续页时保持筛选条件一致
parameters.name: types

parameters.help_en:
The source of the memory. Valid values:
session_extraction: Extracted from session events.
content_extraction: Extracted from text or messages.
direct: Written directly
parameters.help_zh: 记忆来源：session_extraction 表示从会话事件提取，content_extraction 表示从文本或消息提取，direct 表示直接写入
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the memory is valid. Default value: true. If this parameter is omitted, only valid records are returned. If set to false, revoked records are returned
parameters.help_zh: 省略默认 true，仅返回有效记录；false 返回已撤销记录
parameters.name: valid

parameters.help_en: The start time for filtering by update time. The time must be in RFC 3339 format with a time zone
parameters.help_zh: 更新时间筛选的起始时间，采用带时区的 RFC 3339 格式
parameters.name: updated_at_from

parameters.help_en: The end time for filtering by update time. The time must be in RFC 3339 format with a time zone
parameters.help_zh: 更新时间筛选的截止时间，采用带时区的 RFC 3339 格式
parameters.name: updated_at_to

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records per page. Default value: 50. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 单页最大记录数，默认 50，取值范围 1～100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next page
parameters.name: next_token

createdAt.description_en: The creation time. The time is in RFC 3339 format. The Z at the end of the example indicates the UTC time zone
createdAt.description_zh: 创建时间。采用 RFC 3339 格式；示例末尾的 Z 表示 UTC 时区

agentId.description_en: The agent ID. The length is limited to 1 to 128 UTF-8 bytes. The value cannot contain a forward slash (/) or an asterisk (*). This field is not returned if the memory is not associated with an agent ID
agentId.description_zh: Agent ID，长度限制 1 - 128 UTF-8 字节，不允许包含 / 或使用 *；记忆未关联 Agent ID 时此字段不返回

sessionId.description_en: The session ID. The length is limited to 1 to 128 UTF-8 bytes. The value cannot contain a forward slash (/) or an asterisk (*). This field is not returned if the memory is not associated with a session ID
sessionId.description_zh: Session ID，长度限制 1 - 128 UTF-8 字节，不允许包含 / 或使用 *；记忆未关联 Session ID 时此字段不返回

teamId.description_en: The business team ID defined by the caller. This field cannot be empty when provided and can be up to 128 UTF-8 bytes in length
teamId.description_zh: 由调用方定义的业务团队标识。提供时不能为空，最多 128 个 UTF-8 字节

userId.description_en: The user ID. The length is limited to 1 to 128 UTF-8 bytes. The value cannot contain a forward slash (/) or an asterisk (*). This field is not returned if the memory is not associated with a user ID
userId.description_zh: 用户 ID，长度限制 1 - 128 UTF-8 字节，不允许包含 / 或使用 *；记忆未关联用户 ID 时此字段不返回

source.description_en:
The source of the memory. Valid values:
session_extraction: Extracted from session events.
content_extraction: Extracted from text or messages.
direct: Written directly
source.description_zh: 记忆来源：session_extraction 表示从会话事件提取，content_extraction 表示从文本或消息提取，direct 表示直接写入

type.description_en:
The memory content type. Valid values:
semantic: Semantic memory.
skill: Skill.
user_profile: User preference.
session_summary: Session summary
type.description_zh: 记忆内容类型：semantic 为语义记忆，skill 为技能，user_profile 为用户偏好，session_summary 为会话摘要

updatedAt.description_en: The last update time. The time is in RFC 3339 format. The Z at the end of the example indicates the UTC time zone
updatedAt.description_zh: 最后更新时间。采用 RFC 3339 格式；示例末尾的 Z 表示 UTC 时区

valid.description_en: Indicates whether the memory is valid. A value of false indicates that the memory is revoked and is not included in valid memory retrieval
valid.description_zh: 记忆是否有效。false 表示已撤销，不参与有效记忆检索

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records per page

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
